MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

2. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 18
   C. 8
   D. 11

3. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 20

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 15

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 1

12. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 10
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 18 − 8
3. x = 10
Final Answer: x = 10
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. D — 20
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 5
3. Product = 20
Final Answer: 20
